meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas (live data, not an archived version; give corpus_snapshot and source_commit). doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: AMPK also hits mTORC1 directly by phosphorylating Raptor, imposing a metabolic checkpoint independent of TSC.
data.mechanism_beginner: AMPK also hits mTORC1 directly, adding a second, energy-based checkpoint on top of TSC.
data.context: The Raptor arm is the TSC2-independent route, which is why it is measurable in TSC-null cells. Its relative contribution versus the TSC2 arm varies by cell type and by how deep the energy stress is.
data.boundary: Cell biochemistry in human and mouse cells (GWI2008) plus one study in aged mice (YAN2026B). Direct Raptor phosphorylation is shown in cells; how much it adds beside the TSC route in living tissue, and in people, is not shown.
